[आ-अट्-इण्] 
__1 A kind of bird (शरारि) (also written आटि) cf. आटिराडी शराडी च शरारी राडिराडिका 
__2 A sort of fish. 
-Comp. 
-मुखः, खम् a surgical instrument used in blood letting (so called from its being like the beak of the bird आटि).

आटिक,
आटिक्य a. [आटाय गमनाय प्रवृत्तः ठन्, ष्यञ् वा] Able to wander, being on a voyage or journey. 
-की 
__1 A woman fit to go out (अनुपजातपयोधरादिस्त्रीव्यञ्जना [[Śaṅkara.]]). 
__2 N. of the wife of Uṣasti; [[Ch.
[आटीक्-ल्युट्] The leaping motion of a calf; so आटीलकम्.
